F33-5 Electrical test terms on the MSC-1 single-line diagram
20 kV feeder Q11 · CT 1500/1 A 5P20 · 12/20 (24) kV XLPE cable · 2.5 MVA 20/0.415 kV block transformer, 3,478 A · 415 V board · 2.5 MW UPS block
• Contact resistance of Q11 is judged against the lowest pole plus 50 %, and the 20 kV IR minimum is 10,000 MΩ at 5,000 V DC (25 kV class, confirm against
• The block transformer turns ratio passes within ±0.5 % of nameplate on every tap, and the 415 V board IR minimum is 100 MΩ at 1,000 V DC.
